# goslop text fixture — CWE-88 named-option value argv (safe)
lang: python
file: CWE-88-named-option-safe.py
---
import subprocess
import sys

THIS = __file__


def run_benchmark(library: str, scenario: str, n: int, timeout: float) -> None:
    proc = subprocess.run(
        [
            sys.executable,
            THIS,
            "--worker",
            "--library",
            library,
            "--scenario",
            scenario,
            "-n",
            str(n),
        ],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=timeout,
    )
